To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we present a box refinement method for object proposals, which is a preprocessing step for object detection and segmentation.
we propose to use contour as an effective cue to improve the object proposals.
we propose a box-refinement method by searching for a contour that best matches the initial bounding box and that our box-refinement method significantly improves the performance of object proposals.
In summary, our research is concerned with
two aspects of object proposals.
how to improve the quality of object proposals and we propose a box-refinement algorithm for this goal.
how to enhance and prune the initial object proposals to improve the overall performance of CNN-based object detectors.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
we propose a novel box refinement method that improves the localization of initial proposals and the overall detection performance of CNN detectors.
our box refinement can be used to enhance and prune the initial object proposals.
our box refinement process improves the object proposal generation methods and can be used to improve the performance of the CNN detectors.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we propose a box proposal method based on contours, which can be used to enhance the performance of any existing object proposals.
our box refinement can be applied to any proposal generation method to improve the performance.
our method can improve the performance of the object proposal generation by a large margin.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the contour cost is a good indicator of the localization bias and the contour cost can be effectively minimized by searching for the contour that is most consistent with the image.
the contour-based box refinement can be easily integrated into existing methods to enhance the performance of proposal generation.
